title: Notion memo creation from audio upload
breadth_reason: This script tests the ability to create a CRM memo in Notion using an audio upload, extending breadth by requiring ASR on uploaded audio and verifying the signed-in Notion surface.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: User must be signed into Notion in their primary Chrome profile with Notion tab visible.
v7_target.proof_rule: Proof must show the actual Notion page with the new memo created, using a screenshot or DOM capture from the user's Chrome session.

primary_user_input.reason: Using uploaded audio ensures ASR coverage for mp3 files, a common user input mode that requires accurate transcription for note creation.

moments.description: User navigates to anticipy.ai/app, signs in, downloads installer, installs engine.
Driver checks that Notion is signed in and visible in Chrome.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a new record in my Notion Memos database titled Office relocation checklist and include movers, internet provider, new chairs, and key handoff. If you cannot prove the visible Notion surface or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger must deliver the audio artifact via the 'say' command, ensuring it is a per-run audio file.

moments.description: Engine verifies that ASR output is within boundaries and matches spoken text.
Engine decides to act (create Notion memo), ask for clarification, or decline based on surface verification.
Driver observes that only audio upload mode was used and no other input modes were available.

success_criteria: The user successfully uploads an mp3 audio file through the /api/listen/upload endpoint.
The ASR component accurately transcribes the spoken request.
The system identifies that Notion is the target surface and checks for signed-in state.
If Notion is signed-in and visible, a new record is created in the Notion Memos database with the specified fields.
If the surface is not verifiable, the system declines without writing anything.
failure_triggers: The audio file is not uploaded or is corrupted.
The ASR fails to transcribe or produces inaccurate text.
Notion surface is not signed-in or not visible in Chrome.
The engine cannot prove the surface or declines incorrectly.
